synthesis.overnight_summary: Gold extended its post-midterm rally overnight: spot ran from ~$4,050 at the MCX close to ~$4,136 by 08:41 IST (day high $4,140.90), taking out Kitco's $4,068 and Mitrade's $4,104-4,115 resistance. The drivers are the Democratic sweep of Congress (dollar index ~101.3-101.4, US 10Y down to ~4.85% from 4.95%) plus fiscal-risk buying across precious metals (silver +5% on 4-Nov). Brent's slide to ~$93.65 cut inflation and hike fears, but it also removed war premium. December hike odds actually rose to 81.2%, so rates remain the main headwind. The rupee firmed to 94.58 and caps some of the INR gain. With the model fair open at ~146,288 (+3,054 vs the 143,234 derived close), MCX should open sharply higher; whether it chases fair or stalls depends on the first print and the rupee open.

expected_range_mcx.basis: Static elasticity from the 143,234 close at INR 94.58 with a 4050.1 anchor: low = spot $4,068 (Kitco support, the broken R1), high = spot $4,200 (Kitco R2). The 4,140.90 Asian high maps to ~146,470. A stronger rupee open (e.g. 94.40) shifts the whole band down ~270.

synthesis.open_plan: Pre-open is unavailable, so treat the first 09:00-09:15 print against fair ~146,288 (adjust -152 per 10 paise of rupee gain at the open). If the first print is within +/-300 of fair: aligned and tradeable; the trend-day bias favours buying dips toward ~145,150 (spot 4,104) rather than chasing. If it is more than 300 below fair (the market not fully pricing the overnight move): wait 15-30 min, since a lagging open often catches up while spot holds above $4,100. If it is more than 300 above fair: do not chase; overbought, and payrolls is ahead. Keep size light into BoE (17:30 IST) and jobless claims (19:00 IST).
synthesis.invalidation: The bullish bias fails if spot loses $4,068 (MCX ~143,880) on a closing basis, or if the dollar index recovers above ~101.9 (the pre-election level) or December hike odds go above 86% (T5). A move back below $4,000 (MCX ~141,450) would negate the post-election breakout.
